signed.method: Shuffle whole case exposure trajectories against recipient case outcomes. Cases are sorted by anchor_frame_index; when donor and recipient lengths differ, donor values are mapped by nearest relative-anchor position. Refit the original frame model with recipient context_cell fixed effects and case-clustered inference.
